ayahs.text: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا

tr.sahih: By the [winds] scattering [dust], dispersing [it]
tr.pickthall: By those that winnow with a winnowing

ayahs.text: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا

tr.sahih: And the [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
tr.pickthall: And those that bear the burden (of the rain)

ayahs.text: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا

tr.sahih: And the ships sailing with ease
tr.pickthall: And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)

ayahs.text: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا

tr.sahih: And the [angels] apportioning [each] matter,
tr.pickthall: And those who distribute (blessings) by command,

ayahs.text: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ

tr.sahih: Indeed, what you are promised is true.
tr.pickthall: Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened is indeed true,

ayahs.text: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ

tr.sahih: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.
tr.pickthall: And lo! the judgment will indeed befall.

ayahs.text: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ

tr.sahih: By the heaven containing pathways,
tr.pickthall: By the heaven full of paths,

ayahs.text: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ

tr.sahih: Indeed, you are in differing speech.
tr.pickthall: Lo! ye, forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the truth).

ayahs.text: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ

tr.sahih: Deluded away from it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is he who is deluded.
tr.pickthall: He is made to turn away from it who is (himself) averse.

ayahs.text: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ

tr.sahih: Destroyed are the misinformers
tr.pickthall: Accursed be the conjecturers

ayahs.text: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ

tr.sahih: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.
tr.pickthall: Who are careless in an abyss!

ayahs.text: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ

tr.sahih: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"
tr.pickthall: They ask: When is the Day of Judgment?

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ

tr.sahih: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire.
tr.pickthall: (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire,

ayahs.text: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ

tr.sahih: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."
tr.pickthall: (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten.

ayahs.text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ

tr.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
tr.pickthall: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings,

ayahs.text: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ

tr.sahih: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
tr.pickthall: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good;

ayahs.text: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ

tr.sahih: They used to sleep but little of the night,
tr.pickthall: They used to sleep but little of the night,

ayahs.text: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ

words.gloss: And in the hours before dawn

tr.sahih: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
tr.pickthall: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness,

ayahs.text: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ

tr.sahih: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
tr.pickthall: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share.

ayahs.text: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ

tr.sahih: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
tr.pickthall: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure.

ayahs.text: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ

tr.sahih: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
tr.pickthall: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see?

ayahs.text: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ

tr.sahih: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
tr.pickthall: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised;

ayahs.text: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ

tr.sahih: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
tr.pickthall: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak.

ayahs.text: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ

tr.sahih: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -
tr.pickthall: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)?

ayahs.text: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ

tr.sahih: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown."
tr.pickthall: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me).

ayahs.text: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ

tr.sahih: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf.
tr.pickthall: Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf;

ayahs.text: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ

tr.sahih: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"
tr.pickthall: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat?

ayahs.text: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ

words.gloss: and they gave him glad tidings

tr.sahih: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
tr.pickthall: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son.

ayahs.text: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ

tr.sahih: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
tr.pickthall: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!

ayahs.text: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ

tr.sahih: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."
tr.pickthall: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower.

ayahs.text: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ

tr.sahih: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
tr.pickthall: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)?

ayahs.text: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ

tr.sahih: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
tr.pickthall: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk,

ayahs.text: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ

tr.sahih: To send down upon them stones of clay,
tr.pickthall: That we may send upon them stones of clay,

ayahs.text: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ

tr.sahih: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."
tr.pickthall: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton.

ayahs.text: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: So We brought out whoever was in them [i.e., the cities] of the believers.
tr.pickthall: Then we brought forth such believers as were there.

ayahs.text: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ

tr.sahih: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.
tr.pickthall: But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah).

ayahs.text: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ

tr.sahih: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
tr.pickthall: And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom.

ayahs.text: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ

tr.sahih: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
tr.pickthall: And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant,

ayahs.text: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ

tr.sahih: But he turned away with his supporters and said, "A magician or a madman."
tr.pickthall: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman.

ayahs.text: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ

tr.sahih: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
tr.pickthall: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate.

ayahs.text: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ

tr.sahih: And in ʿAad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.
tr.pickthall: And in (the tribe of) A'ad (there is a portent) when we sent the fatal wind against them.

ayahs.text: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ

tr.sahih: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
tr.pickthall: It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust.

ayahs.text: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ

tr.sahih: And in Thamūd, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."
tr.pickthall: And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile.

ayahs.text: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ

tr.sahih: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
tr.pickthall: But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed;

ayahs.text: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ

tr.sahih: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
tr.pickthall: And they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.

ayahs.text: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ

tr.sahih: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
tr.pickthall: And the folk of Noah aforetime. Lo! they were licentious folk.

ayahs.text: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ

tr.sahih: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.
tr.pickthall: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof).

ayahs.text: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَـٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَـٰهِدُونَ

tr.sahih: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
tr.pickthall: And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)!

ayahs.text: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ

tr.sahih: And of all things We created two mates [i.e., counterparts]; perhaps you will remember.
tr.pickthall: And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect.

ayahs.text: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

tr.sahih: So flee to Allāh. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
tr.pickthall: Therefor flee unto Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from him.

ayahs.text: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

tr.sahih: And do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
tr.pickthall: And set not any other god along with Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him.

ayahs.text: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ

tr.sahih: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
tr.pickthall: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman!

ayahs.text: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ

words.gloss: Have they transmitted it to them
Have they transmitted it to them

tr.sahih: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
tr.pickthall: Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another? Nay, but they are froward folk.

ayahs.text: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ

tr.sahih: So leave them, [O Muḥammad], for you are not to be blamed.
tr.pickthall: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), for thou art in no wise blameworthy,

ayahs.text: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

tr.sahih: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
tr.pickthall: And warn, for warning profiteth believers.

ayahs.text: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ

tr.sahih: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
tr.pickthall: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me.

ayahs.text: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ

tr.sahih: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
tr.pickthall: I seek no livelihood from them, nor do I ask that they should feed Me.

ayahs.text: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ

tr.sahih: Indeed, it is Allāh who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
tr.pickthall: Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might.

ayahs.text: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَـٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ

words.gloss: so let them not ask Me to hasten
so let them not ask Me to hasten

tr.sahih: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their companions [i.e., predecessors], so let them not impatiently urge Me.
tr.pickthall: And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day).

ayahs.text: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ

tr.sahih: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
tr.pickthall: And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised.
